# Phantom Secrets

> Agents start here. Commands below are copy-paste. They do not print secret values.

Full reference: [docs/llms.txt](docs/llms.txt) and [docs/llms-full.txt](docs/llms-full.txt).
Published copies: https://phm.dev/llms.txt and https://phm.dev/llms-full.txt.
Repository: https://github.com/ashlrai/phantom-secrets
Walkthrough: [docs/agent-quickstart.md](docs/agent-quickstart.md)
Distribution evidence: [docs/distribution-status.md](docs/distribution-status.md)

## Install on macOS

```bash
brew tap ashlrai/phantom && brew trust --formula ashlrai/phantom/phantom && brew install ashlrai/phantom/phantom
```

## Commands

```bash
phantom init
phantom status --json
phantom list --json
phantom agent doctor --json
phantom setup --client claude
phantom setup --client cursor
phantom setup --client codex
phantom check
phantom why OPENAI_API_KEY --json
```

Install both verified `v0.7.9` binaries before setup. Version `0.7.9` has no network package-runner fallback and fails closed when neither local runtime is executable.

## MCP files

Claude Code writes `.mcp.json`. Cursor writes `~/.cursor/mcp.json`. Both use this shape. Setup fills `command` with the binary path it found:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "phantom": {
      "command": "phantom",
      "args": ["mcp", "serve"]
    }
  }
}
```

Codex writes `~/.codex/config.toml`:

```toml
[mcp_servers.phantom]
command = "phantom"
args = ["mcp", "serve"]
```
